data.narrative:
ADASI is a sovereign-funded Defense & Security company acquired by EDGE Group. The valuation universe consists of 23 same-sector peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable in this case. The Defense & Security sector contains insufficient comparable transactions at ADASI's stage and tier. While 23 same-sector peers exist, zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches were identified—falling below the minimum threshold of three datapoints required for meaningful median analysis. A sector-wide median would conflate highly disparate company profiles and introduce substantial noise.

The absence of clean comparable multiples constrains quantitative triangulation to a single method. Given the acquired status and sovereign funding structure, transaction analysis or precedent M&A multiples would be the most direct valuation approach, but specific transaction data is not provided. The narrow comparable set and sovereign-funding context create material uncertainty around any point estimate. Valuation support would require either: (1) access to specific comparable transaction terms within the sovereign-backed Defense & Security subsector, or (2) bottom-up DCF analysis using ADASI-specific financials and risk parameters. No single defensible range can be derived from available data.
